C0747.title: Laptop theft: a case study on the effectiveness of security mechanisms in open organizations
C0747.summary: A study examining laptop theft incidents at two universities, analyzing the effectiveness of physical, social, and digital security mechanisms in preventing laptop theft within open organizations. It highlights that open-access environments such as hospitals and universities are prime targets for laptop theft due to high daily foot traffic.
